periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis of each patch is angled approximately 45 degrees inward and downward relative to the horizontal facial midline.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology; the vertical axis is approximately 1.5 times the length of the horizontal axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering toward the muzzle, with the lowest point extending significantly below the geometric center of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The black band is broad, occupying approximately 40-50% of the visible torso height from the shoulder down to the occlusion point.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ears are set wide apart on the crown, with a gap roughly equal to 1.5 times the width of an individual ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior boundary of each ear exhibits a smooth, semi-circular curvature.

other_distinctive_markers: Noticeable brownish-yellow discoloration present throughout the ventral and abdominal fur regions.
